Summary: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics / in-app guidance). Evaluating Redwood hosted API for fast time-to-value, then Dedicated for predictable latency and EU data residency. Short timeline: exec sponsor + product lead pushing for POC in March.

Recent activity:
- 2026-02-12: Intro demo (hosted API) with AE/SE; product demo + sample prompt set. (ff_2026-02-12_emberleaf-demo)
- 2026-02-20: Security questionnaire submitted; requested SOC2 evidence & KMS integration details.
- 2026-03-03: Security deep-dive with SE + security; clarifications on audit logs and retention (ff_2026-03-03_security_qna).
- 2026-03-05: POC kickoff email thread; agreed scope: chat support + semantic doc search on EU region; 2-week POC. (thread-Gm:17648231)
- 2026-03-09: Pricing call with finance; asked for Dedicated reserved pricing vs hosted blended estimate; requested 12-month vs 36-month options. (thread-Gm:17688702-pricing)

Requirements / Notes:
- Primary workload: real-time support chat (low latency) + nightly batch embeddings for search.
- Targets: p50 latency <80ms for short chats, p95 <200ms; throughput: ~15 reqs/sec average, spikes to 60 reqs/sec during events.
- Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, prefer staged approach (start hosted API, migrate heavy traffic to Dedicated).
- Model preferences: latest open-model variants (quantized), allow Redwood model recommendations. Must support function-calling for structured responses.
- Residency: all PII and conversational logs must remain in EU. CTO quote: "We cannot allow conversational PII to leave EU boundaries; caching may be within EU only."
- Multi-region routing: want EU primary with failover to other EU zones; ask about cross-region read-only fallbacks only if EU capacity exhausted. Concern: latency tradeoffs if using centralized non-EU fallback.
- Security: require SSO (SAML), KMS integration for key management, retention controls (90/365 day policies), audit logs to be shipped to their SIEM.

POC scope:
- Run hosted API in eu-west region with sample traffic for 2 weeks. Measure p50/p95, token cost, and KV-prefix cache hit rates.
- If hosted meets SLA for baseline load, test Dedicated sizing (2 x A100 equivalent) in staging for steady-state performance and cost comparison.

Quotes / Snippets:
- Product Lead: "We need predictable cost and repeatable perf — if the Hosted path proves reliable, we can lean on Redwood for scaling but our legal team will insist on residency guarantees."
- CTO: "Latency for EU users is critical; 150ms client->response is upper bound during spikes."

Open items / Ask from Redwood:
- Provide explicit EU-only data residency contract clause sample and KMS integration guide.
- Dedicated reserved pricing for 12/36 month with committed throughput numbers and burst policy.
- Clarify multi-region routing: how failover behaves, where KV cache lives, and whether fallbacks can be restricted to EU zones only.

- AE to circulate Dedicated pricing matrix and capacity recommendation by 2026-03-15.
